## About
The Oil Exchange on Outer Drive in West Dearborn does full service oil changes the way they should be done. We change your oil and filter, check your fluids, tire pressure, wipers, lights and filters, and clean your windows before you go.
When your car needs more than an oil change, our mechanic shop has you covered: tune-ups, shocks, mufflers, brakes, tires, alignment, transmission and engine. Front end to rear end, we handle it all. Call or stop by for an estimate.
We're rated 4.6 on Google from 435 reviews, and we'd like to be your go-to spot too.

## Services
- Full Service Oil Exchange: Oil and filter change, plus we check and fill washer fluid, check tire pressure, wiper blades, lights, brake, power steering, transmission and coolant fluids, air and cabin filters, belts, and clean your windows.
- Tire Rotation: Keep your tires wearing evenly. Easy to add on to your oil change.
- Transmission Flush: Fresh transmission fluid, plus transmission filter service.
- Radiator Flush: Clear out old coolant and refill your cooling system.
- AC Recharge: Get your air conditioning blowing cold again.
- Mechanic services: Tune-ups, shocks, mufflers, brakes, tires, alignment, transmission and engine work. Call or visit for an estimate.
- Fleet service: We accept national fleets including ARI, Donlien, Wheels, PHH, GE and Union Leasing.
- Filters and wiper blades: Air filters, cabin filters, wiper blades and foreign oil filters on hand.

## FAQ
Q: Do you do more than oil changes?
A: Yes. We offer a full range of products and services, and our mechanic shop handles tune-ups, shocks, mufflers, brakes, tires, alignment, transmission and engine work.

Q: Can I get an estimate before you start?
A: Sure. Call or stop by and we'll give you an estimate on any of your mechanic needs.

Q: Do you take credit cards?
A: Yes, we accept all major credit cards.

Q: Do you work with company fleets?
A: Yes. We accept national fleets including ARI, Donlien, Wheels, PHH, GE and Union Leasing.

Q: What are your Sunday hours?
A: We're open Sunday from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
